title: Candice Local Preferences — version 2 proposal
note: WS-34 (WR-018) proposal against WR-010-owned packages/candice-protocol/schemas/preferences.schema.json. Application is the integration/release owner's (manifest 9.4 class 2). Field names align to the v1 protocol contract; v1 runtime alias `textScale` maps to the `textSize` enum; `lastAnswerMethod` is renamed to `lastUsedAnswerMethod`; `companionPosition {left,top}` becomes `companionScreenPosition {x,y,anchor}`.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. WS-34 migrates integer 1 -> integer 2; the published string version is this lane's proposal to WR-010.

preferredName.description: The user's stated preferred name. Never inferred from the OS username (spec 4). Null until asked.

lastUsedAnswerMethod.description: Remembered convenience only; never a lock (spec 5.1).

reducedMotion.description: Null = follow OS reduced-motion; true = force minimal animation; false = animations allowed (spec 10).

x.description: Screen x offset in points relative to the bound terminal anchor, or free position when floating.

anchor.description: Anchoring preference beside the bound terminal, or independent movable floating mode.

companionScreenPosition.description: Remembered preferred offset; the user may always reposition.

nameAskedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the first-run name question was asked. Null when never asked. Deprecated in v3 in favor of nameAsked.
